lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Colonel's ShotNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 56ENGLISH DOCTOR SHOT DEAD AT THE REICHENBACH FALLS: AIR-GUN SUSPECTEDThe report of an air-gun is small, and is lost entirely in the roar of the water. The guides, who come up with their lanterns in the early dark, find no struggle and no robbery, only a body on a rock and a living man sitting beside it, not speaking. The Professor lies at the foot of the Falls. The Colonel is taken at Interlaken three days later, quietly, in a railway carriage. It is no consolation. The war is won, and a friend is dead, and the long ride home in a first-class carriage is the quietest you have ever known. He is remembered as a man who knew how to work with others: a Doctor, a Brother, an Inspector, a Boy.
